stable.notes: Work becomes a dashboard: Board shows the sessions Work sent above the board (running, waiting on you, reply ready, needs attention) with Open session and Mark reviewed; Focus opens an item with its Agent workspace pinned beside it. Drag a card onto Start work and an overlay confirms where it goes before anything is sent. Finished replies can be marked reviewed, failures acknowledged with their reason kept, and a stuck unconfirmed delivery cleared after a check. Pairs with server 6.57.1.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
